blurb_zh: 距离和路上时间的关系
scene_zh: 一份上班族通勤记录（模拟数据）

views.subject: commute distance and travel time
views.subtitle_en: Commute distance plotted against travel time.

examples.en: The dots climb from left to right: a 10 km trip takes 42 minutes, and a 40 km trip takes 110.
examples.zh: 点从左往右上升：10 公里用 42 分钟，40 公里用 110 分钟。

features.note_zh: 描述整体关系用 go together 或 positive link；点越靠右越高就是正相关。
features.interpret_zh: 整组数据同向变化，但只能说明距离和用时一起变，不能说明距离导致用时。

examples.en: A dense group sits between 8 and 16 km, with times from 31 to 58 minutes.
examples.zh: 8 到 16 公里之间有一组密集的点，用时 31 到 58 分钟。

features.note_zh: dense group / cluster 指一群点挤在同一区域。
features.interpret_zh: 这一段的点挨得近，说明很多人通勤距离相近，不等于体感一样。

examples.en: Inside the 17 to 25 km band the pattern is looser: 22 km takes 57 minutes, while 25 km takes 82.
examples.zh: 17 到 25 公里这段关系松一些：22 公里用 57 分钟，25 公里却要 82 分钟。

features.note_zh: moderate / loose link 用来描述趋势有、但点不贴近一条线的关系。
features.interpret_zh: 同样是二十多公里，用时能差 25 分钟，说明还有别的因素在起作用。

examples.en: Above 25 km the dots rise again: 28 km takes 88 minutes and 40 km takes 110.
examples.zh: 25 公里以上的点再次上升：28 公里用 88 分钟，40 公里用 110 分钟。

features.note_zh: 分段描述时用 above / beyond + 数值，避免把整段说成一个斜率。
features.interpret_zh: 长距离段贴得更紧，但这段样本本身更少，别外推到全城。

examples.en: Two dots sit far from the rest: 45 km takes just 52 minutes, and 6 km takes 78.
examples.zh: 有两个点明显偏离其他点：45 公里只用了 52 分钟，6 公里却用了 78 分钟。

features.note_zh: outlier 指落在趋势之外的观测；先核查记录，再解释成因。
features.interpret_zh: 长途反而快、短途反而慢，可能和快线、堵点或记录方式有关，图里看不出原因。

views.overview_zh: 整体看，距离越远用时越长，两者同向变化；8 到 16 公里点最密，17 到 25 公里关系变松，还有两个点明显偏离趋势。相关不等于因果。

general.a2: The dots go up from left to right. Longer commutes usually take more time: a 10 km trip takes about 42 minutes, and a 40 km trip takes 110. A few trips do not fit this pattern.
general.b1: Travel time and distance move together closely. A 10 km trip takes 42 minutes, while 40 km takes 110. Most trips between 8 and 16 km take 31 to 58 minutes, and two dots sit far from the trend.
general.b2: The scatter shows a strong positive association between commute distance and travel time, with points rising from 3 km and 18 minutes to 40 km and 110 minutes. The link is looser between 17 and 25 km, and two observations, at 45 km and 6 km, break the pattern.

descriptions.ielts: Travel time rose steadily with commute distance, from 18 minutes at 3 km to 110 minutes at 40 km. Most observations clustered between 8 and 16 km, while two trips, 45 km in 52 minutes and 6 km in 78 minutes, lay outside the main trend.
descriptions.business: Commute time tracks distance closely across this sample: each extra kilometer comes with roughly one and a half more minutes on the road. Short trips are the least predictable, and the two outliers are worth checking before using distance as a planning input.

views.subject: Average commute time by mode
views.subtitle_en: Typical one-way commute time by mode.

examples.en: Metro plus bus has the longest commute, at 55 minutes.
examples.zh: 地铁加公交用时最长，为 55 分钟。

features.note_zh: 时间最长用 the longest；the highest figure 也可以，但 long 更贴合时间。
features.interpret_zh: 换乘多一段，时间就上去了；不过这是平均值，不说明每个人的情况。

examples.en: Bus and metro plus bus are close: 51 versus 55 minutes.
examples.zh: 公交和地铁加公交很接近：51 分钟对 55 分钟。

features.note_zh: 差距小用 close 或 a narrow gap；versus 用来摆两个数值。
features.interpret_zh: 两种方式几乎一样慢，选哪个更多看线路和换乘次数。

examples.en: Walking is the lowest, at 15 minutes.
examples.zh: 步行用时最短，为 15 分钟。

features.note_zh: the lowest / the shortest；low 说数值，时间更自然用 short。
features.interpret_zh: 步行样本可能住得离公司近，不能和其他方式直接比距离。

examples.zh: 开车排第四，为 38 分钟。

features.note_zh: rank + 序数词，不加 the；也可以说 come fourth。
features.interpret_zh: 这里只算路上时间，找车位和堵车的波动会让实际体验更差。

examples.en: The subway takes 42 minutes, four minutes longer than driving at 38.
examples.zh: 地铁用 42 分钟，比开车的 38 分钟多 4 分钟。

features.note_zh: 比较时间用 longer than，不用 higher than。
features.interpret_zh: 地铁和开车只差 4 分钟，说明这条线路上换乘的损耗不明显。

views.overview_zh: 各方式平均用时从 15 到 55 分钟不等：地铁加公交最慢，步行最快。开车和地铁只差 4 分钟。平均值看不出线路长短和换乘次数。

general.a2: Walking is the fastest way here, at 15 minutes. Metro plus bus is the slowest, at 55 minutes. Bus, subway, and car take between 38 and 51 minutes. The e-bike sits in the middle, at 28 minutes.
general.b1: Average commute time ranges from 15 minutes on foot to 55 minutes on metro plus bus. The subway takes 42 minutes, only four minutes slower than driving, while the bus takes 51 minutes.
general.b2: Commute time varies widely by mode, from 15 minutes on foot to 55 minutes for a metro and bus trip. The subway and car sit close together, at 42 and 38 minutes, while the bus is slower at 51 minutes and the e-bike faster at 28.

descriptions.ielts: Average commute time was shortest on foot, at 15 minutes, and longest on metro plus bus, at 55 minutes. The subway and car recorded similar figures, at 42 and 38 minutes, while the bus took 51 minutes.
descriptions.business: Rail and road options cluster between 38 and 55 minutes, while walking is a 15-minute niche. The four-minute gap between subway and car suggests little to gain from switching modes without changing the route.
